svg.title: ENA bought under StablecoinX's two token purchase agreements and still locked, on the old schedule and with the October 5, 2026 waiver
svg.desc: Stepped line chart from July 2025 to September 2029. On the old 48-month schedule the locked count was 2.15B ENA from September 30, 2025, fell in steps from July 31, 2026, stood at 1.56B on October 5, 2026 and would have reached zero on September 30, 2029. With the waiver it fell from 1.56B to zero on October 5, 2026. Dates follow the dashboard's assumption that each purchase completed at the end of its month.
svg.text: On October 5 the waiver unlocked 1.56B ENA the old schedule held until 2029
ENA bought under the two token purchase agreements and still locked, on the dashboard's schedule dates
Still locked on the old schedule after the waiver
